newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bonds fall with Germany, seen bottoming out.
newsitem.headline: Danish bonds fall with Germany, seen bottoming out.

text.p: Danish bond prices followed the German market down on Monday but dealers said they believed the falling trend had bottomed out for the day.

"It is ongoing fears about EMU's starting date which have hit the market but I think prices will stabilise at their current levels with the 2006 benchmark trading within the 110.20-70 range for the rest of the day," a dealer said.

The benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 was down 0.34 point from the opening at 110.26, yielding 6.45 percent in turnover of 2.1 billion crowns while its March future rose 0.11 point to 110.65 with 129 contracts traded.
